verdict.rationale: Cactus runs a hosted platform that accepts uploaded data and training jobs, so retention and deletion controls are a fair question for it. The pack documents no retention settings, deletion endpoints or data-lifecycle policy. The on-device claim that no data leaves the device is a different privacy property, not a retention or deletion control, so it earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
